features.quote: Cap the number of agent turns
features.justification_quote: To keep it cheap and fast

features.quote: Terminate when: 1. Model passes tests 2. Model explicitly abandons 3. Max turns reached 4. Model becomes nonresponsive 5. Tool budget exhausted
Recommended Turn Limit: Use 6 to 10 turns. Good default: 8 turns total. Enough for repeated failure to become salient. Not too expensive
